say:1:1033317001:1.text: Oh, sure. That kid's always coming to buy things. We got to know each other after a while, and now he'll sometimes tinker away right in the yard.
say:1:1033317001:1.source_cn: 是啊，那孩子总是来买东西。一来二去，我们就熟起来了，他...
say:1:1033317001:1.male: Oh, sure. That kid's always coming to buy things. We got to know each other after a while, and now he'll sometimes tinker away right in the yard.
say:1:1033317001:1.female: Oh, sure. That kid's always coming to buy things. We got to know each other after a while, and now he'll sometimes tinker away right in the yard.

say:2:1033317002:1.text: He has a lot of failures, however, and few true successes. He often makes a total mess of my garden, too.
say:2:1033317002:1.source_cn: 不过他的实验一直是失败多，真正成功的少之又少，连带着我...
say:2:1033317002:1.male: He has a lot of failures, however, and few true successes. He often makes a total mess of my garden, too.
say:2:1033317002:1.female: He has a lot of failures, however, and few true successes. He often makes a total mess of my garden, too.

say:3:1033317003:1.text: Honestly, I spend half my time patching him up... Either blown up by his own inventions, or falling off something or other.
say:3:1033317003:1.source_cn: 说真的，我至少有一半时间是在给他治伤……要么是被自己的...
say:3:1033317003:1.male: Honestly, I spend half my time patching him up... Either blown up by his own inventions, or falling off something or other.
say:3:1033317003:1.female: Honestly, I spend half my time patching him up... Either blown up by his own inventions, or falling off something or other.

say:4:1033317004:1.source_cn: 唉……这孩子，真让人发愁啊。
